Gene: Gene that the resource is related to
Title: Name/title of the dataset
Assay_ID: Assay(s) associated with the data (BAO IDs)
Data_format: Data file format(s) - MS, txt, HDF5, etc.
Data_link: Link to external data repository containing key dataset metadata
Endpoint: Data endpoint format (log2 expression, fold change, etc.)
Endpoint_detection: Physical entity/method to calculate endpoint - fluorescence intensity, mass spec, etc.
Activity: On target activity as reported to chemicalprobes.org
External ID: External ID (PubChem, CheBI, ZINC, etc.) corresponding to the canonical representation
External ID registration system: Repository corresponding to the external ID
Ligand type: Mode of action towards given gene
Link to the supporting data: External link to the data deposited in public repository/location
Name: Canonical (trade or IUPAC) name of molecule
Negative control: Name and structure of inactive analog (probe is the active analog in the 'probe pair')
Probe page: Link to chemicalprobes.org where the probe is registered
Repository page: Link to the vendor for the physical sample
Selectivity: Selectivity against similar genes as reported to chemicalprobes.or
